{{Dialogue|Sergeant|General Skywalker, we've established contact with Rodia.|Skywalker|Rex, keep up the bombardment. I'll be back soon.|Rex|Yes, sir.|attr=A clone sergeant, Anakin Skywalker, and Clone Captain Rex|src=<ref name="Transfer" />}}
A '''battle''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], wherein [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], engaged enemy forces on a [[Unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)|planet]] with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and several [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]]. After Skywalker received word of the [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|capture]] of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], Skywalker sent his Padawan to assist in the transfer of Gunray to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], while Skywalker himself remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to finish the battle.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Ahsoka, ''listen'' to me. I would go myself, but I'm needed here.''"<br />"''Oh, and ''I'm not?''|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Transfer" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Transfer Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]; his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," arrived on a [[Unidentified planet (Skywalker and Tano)|planet]] and engaged enemy forces stationed there. Setting up a base, the Republic forces employed [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] against the enemy's [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. While Skywalker and Rex stayed outside to keep a lookout and command the cannons, Tano took refuge inside the base to look up data.<ref name="Transfer" />

[[File:Get_her_back.png|thumb|left|230px|Skywalker loses contact with Amidala.]]
Skywalker and his forces received word of a [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|coup]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and a [[Unidentified clone sergeant (Amidala's transmission)|clone sergeant]] was able to establish contact with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Skywalker left Rex to keep up the heavy artillery bombardment while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] went to talk with his secret [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], inside the base. Conferring through a [[Hologram/Legends|hololink]], Skywalker learned that Amidala had settled the coup, but that she had also been involved in the capture of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on Rodia; the viceroy was to be transported to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stand trial for his war crimes. However, interference from enemy artillery caused the connection to be severed before the discussion could continue.<ref name="Transfer" />

Unable to leave because he was needed to command the Republic forces on the planet, Skywalker instead sent his Padawan to oversee the transfer of Gunray and protect the Senator. Tano departed in a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], leaving her master to finish the battle.<ref name="Transfer" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|With all due respect, I am only three parsecs from Rodia now. I feel I should&hellip;I should continue to carry out the orders given to me by my master.''"<br />"''Hmm&hellip; A Padawan's place it is to follow her master. Very well, Ahsoka. Proceed you may.|Ahsoka Tano and Master Yoda|<ref name="Transfer" />}}
After receiving clearance from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], Tano was allowed to proceed with her master's assignment.<ref name="Transfer" /> The Padawan arrived on Rodia, and she accompanied Jedi Master [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]] as they escorted Gunray in a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]. Before the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] could jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], however, the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] launched a [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|mission]] to rescue the viceroy in order to prevent him from revealing Confederate secrets under interrogation.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared briefly in [[The Clone Wars: Transfer|''Transfer'']], an [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the weekly [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]] that led into "[[Cloak of Darkness]]," an episode in the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>
